# Provenance
Project-specific firmware, art, game writing and mechanical designs are maintained in this private personal project. Original vendor drawings, code, component documentation and library notices retain their existing terms. Repository visibility does not transfer vendor rights.

The populated display model and board examples derive from Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-3.5B. The angle sensor CAD and board derive from Adafruit 6357. Preserve supplier notices in source and release packages. Review redistribution terms for CAD, binary firmware dependencies and packaged assets before sharing manufacturing packs outside this project. Transfer only approved files to the manufacturing partner.

Waveshare board source: https://github.com/waveshareteam/ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-3.5B
Adafruit angle sensor: https://www.adafruit.com/product/6357

Atkinson Hyperlegible Next supplies the web and LCD lettering. Its bundled source font and license are in game/assets/fonts. The firmware stores small raster subsets generated from that same file.
